title: Airtable update fails with INVALID_VALUE_FOR_COLUMN because a formula or lookup field is in the payload
symptoms: Field "Total" cannot accept the provided value: cannot modify a computed field
Round-trip code that reads a record and writes it back fails
cause: Formula, rollup, lookup, count, autonumber, created and last modified fields are read only. Sending any of them in a write fails the whole request, even with PATCH and an unchanged value.
fix: Write only the fields you changed, and strip read-only fields before sending a record back.
